# Stanton Tree Service

> Stanton Tree Service is a licensed and insured, family-run tree care company serving Atlanta and Metro Atlanta, Georgia. We remove trees (including 24/7 emergency and storm-damage removals), trim and prune trees, and grind stumps for homeowners across the north and central metro. Free written estimates. Phone (470) 914-3402.

## What we do
- Tree removal: dead, dying, leaning, storm-damaged and oversized trees, including sectional takedowns near houses, fences and power lines
- Emergency tree removal: 24/7 response for trees on houses, cars and driveways after storms
- Tree trimming and pruning: crown cleaning, thinning, raising and deadwood removal for oaks, pines, maples and ornamentals
- Stump grinding and removal: below-grade grinding with full cleanup
- Every job comes with a free walkthrough and a written estimate. Licensed and insured in Georgia.

## Service area
- Atlanta and Metro Atlanta, Georgia (service-area business; no walk-in location)
- Tree removal pages: Atlanta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Milton, Johns Creek, Sandy Springs, Marietta, Kennesaw
- Stump grinding pages also cover Acworth, Canton, Decatur, Duluth, Dunwoody, Norcross, Smyrna, Woodstock
- Full list: https://stantontreeservice.com/service-areas/

## Pricing (typical Metro Atlanta ranges, from our cost guide)
- Tree removal: most yards land between $300 and $1,500; small trees sit at the low end, large trees over 60 ft and trees over structures at the high end
- Emergency and after-hours work adds about 20 to 40 percent
- Stump grinding is priced per stump by diameter; see the stump grinding cost guide
- Every quote is written, line by line, before any work starts
- Get a free estimate: https://stantontreeservice.com/contact/ or (470) 914-3402

## Good to know
- Georgia specifics we work with every week: red clay that loosens root plates after heavy rain, tall loblolly pines on small lots, water oaks that fail around 40 years old, Bradford pears that split in storms, and ice-storm cleanups in winter.
- The person who quotes the job is the person who answers the phone during it.
- We never top trees; topping damages a tree and makes it less safe.
